r: I wasn't expecting anybody to be living on this island.
Pleased to meet you, my name is $playername.

ll2_circe_14.m: They keep me company. Men are noisy. Pigs are honest.

ll2_circe_16.m: Yes, yes. You were a sailor once. We've all made mistakes.
r: Eh... well. I better leave now. Good day.

ll2_circe_30.m: You again. Did you forget something?

ll2_circe_32.m: The pigs shuffle. One particularly round pig freezes.

r: He came ashore. With all his men. They vanished. You have pigs.

ll2_circe_36.m: It stamps its hoof, glares at Circe, then at you.

ll2_circe_39.m: It attempts a salute. Falls sideways.

r: That's definitely him. Turn them back.
Looks like he says no. Change them back - NOW!

ll2_circe_43.m: [Admiring] You noticed. Most would have left. Most would not have looked twice at a pig.

ll2_circe_46.m: And another thing, you curly-tailed tyrannesse...

ll2_circe_47.m: Why am I not pink anymore? [He looks at his hands.]

ll2_circe_49.m: I remember mud. And apples. So many delicious apples.

ll2_circe_53b.m: [She produces a small golden key.] Take this.

ll2_circe_54.m: Not yet, not yet. When you find the lock, you will know.

ll2_circe_71.m: You will not stay long. Men rarely do.

ll2_circe_73.m: To the southeast lie the lands of the cyclops.

ll2_circe_74b.m: They are not like other folk. They build no cities. They obey no laws but their own temper.

ll2_circe_75.m: Each one rules his cave as if it were a kingdom.

ll2_circe_76.m: They are strong. Suspicious. And very certain of themselves.

ll2_circe_77.m: [slight smile] They believe they are always the larger mind in the room. That makes bargaining... difficult.

ll2_circe_78.m: Further on you will reach a narrow strait. On one side dwells Scylla.

ll2_circe_79b.m: Scylla does not chase ships. She does not roar warnings. She simply reaches.

ll2_circe_80.m: Six heads. Six mouths. Six chances to lose someone or something.

ll2_circe_81.m: And what she takes, she keeps.

ll2_circe_82.m: Do not challenge her. Do not delay near her rock. Sail past, and accept the loss she takes.

ll2_circe_84.m: [she meets your eyes] Scylla is not cruel. She is simply hungry.

r: Yes, we have met her indeed.

ll2_circe_87.m: She is no creature of claw or tooth. She is hunger in the lake.

ll2_circe_88.m: Three times each day, the waters descend into her throat. Three times they rise again.

ll2_circe_89.m: Ships caught too near are pulled under - not smashed, but taken.

ll2_circe_91.m: Where they go, I cannot say. Some say downward. Some say elsewhere.

ll2_circe_92.m: I have never known a sailor who returned the same.

ll2_circe_94.m: You cannot avoid Scylla. Charybdis or the cyclops are your choice.

ll2_circe_95.m: With Charybdis - I wouldn't trust her, you may lose everything.

ll2_circe_96.m: The cyclops - well, they don't like me. And the feeling is mutual.

ll2_circe_97.m: You survived me. That suggests you prefer thought over force. You will need that.

ll2_circe_99.m: The lake ahead does not hate you. It does not love you either.

lake_map: A map of the Great Lake Laeroth

lake_map.10: The cartographer Thyrope Splathershed asked me to join an expedition to get the maps of Lake Laeroth completed.
lake_map.12: I should get beeswax from Leofric the beekeeper to make earplugs.
lake_map.20: On a paradisiacal island, A woman named Kalypso welcomed me and offered refreshment.
lake_map.22: I took a single grape to try her food. It gave me an extraordinary boost to my vigor.
lake_map.24: Kalypso gave me a tiny green key as a present.
lake_map.26: I realized that I didn't have a desire to leave anymore.
lake_map.28: Once the magic had worn off, I was able to leave the island again.
lake_map.30: You met Circe, a strange, lonely woman who kept pigs in her kitchen.
lake_map.31: We docked at an unknown island. Captain Burry and his men set off to replenish supplies.
lake_map.32: The ship was abandoned. Something was strange about that Circe, I decided to question her.
lake_map.34: I realized that the Captain and his crew had been turned into pigs, and I forced Circe to turn them back.
lake_map.36: Impressed, Circe gave me a golden key as a parting gift.
lake_map.40: We approached the Sirens' Reef. Many sailors have lost their lives here. Captain Burry refused to sail any further.
lake_map.42: I distributed earplugs to the crew so that the sirens' songs could no longer harm them.
lake_map.44: Then I put in earplugs too.
lake_map.46: I had myself tied tightly to the mast so that I could hear what the sirens were singing without jumping overboard.
lake_map.48: We have managed to passage by the Sirens' cliff.
lake_map.50: I was exploring a cave on an island with just sheep, when suddenly the dwarvish cyclops Polyphem enters, together with a flock of sheep. Polyphem has locked the door behind him.
lake_map.52: He and his brothers would eat me in the next days.
lake_map.54: Polyphem fell onto his bed and immediatly began to snore. I should find a way to leave.
lake_map.55: I made a strong soap solution.
lake_map.56: And poured it directly into Polyphem's eye.
lake_map.57: Polyphem let all the sheep out so he could more easily search the cave for me. As he did so, he felt each sheep's back and counted them.
lake_map.58: I hung myself from the side of a strong sheep to let it pull me to freedom.
lake_map.59: It worked! I've left the cave.
lake_map.60: Scylla, the six headed monster, had attacked our ship.
lake_map.62: We managed to defeat one of Scylla's monstrous heads. Rather than weakening her, however, this only seemed to make her more furious.
lake_map.64: We managed to defeat another one of Scylla's monstrous heads. We better had not...
lake_map.70: We were swept into the abyss of the maelstrom along with the ship.
lake_map.900: Looks like we had got the map of the great Lake Laeroth complete.
lake_map.910: Thyrope Splathershed is happy to have the map complete now. He seemed to doubt my story though, but he allowed me to use the ship for my leisure.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
